messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["fox", "barn owl"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A bipedal creature shown in right profile standing on sandy ground, with the head, lower body, legs and tail of a red fox combined with the torso plumage and folded wings of a barn owl. The head is fox-like with a pointed snout, the chest and neck are covered in white speckled owl-like feathers, two large feathered wings are folded against the sides of the body, the hindquarters and two bent furry legs end in clawed paws on the ground, and a very long thick bushy fox tail trails behind along the ground.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "a red fox with pointed snout, black nose, amber eye, white lower cheek and jaw, and reddish-orange fur on top", "part": "head", "where": "at the top of the creature, facing to the right in profile"}, {"looks_like": "tall pointed fox ears with reddish outer fur and pale inner fur with dark bases", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head, held upright"}, {"looks_like": "furry reddish-brown fox hind legs bent at the joint", "part": "legs", "where": "under the lower torso, supporting the upright body down to the ground"}, {"looks_like": "dark brown fox paws with short blunt claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "a long thick bushy fox tail with shaggy reddish-brown fur and a pale tip", "part": "tail", "where": "extending from the rear of the body and trailing back along the ground"}, {"looks_like": "folded barn owl wings with golden-buff, grey and white barred and mottled feathers", "part": "wings", "where": "on the left and right sides of the torso, folded against the body"}, {"looks_like": "soft barn owl plumage, white with fine dark speckles on the front and golden-buff with grey mottling on the back and wings", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the neck, chest, upper back and outer wing surfaces"}, {"looks_like": "fine black speckles and grey mottled patches on white to buff background", "part": "markings", "where": "scattered over the neck, chest, upper back and wings"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
